summary.text: David Graham, a Libertarian and the Libertarian Party of Kansas Vice Chair, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. Senate seat in Kansas to Adam Hamilton.
He had also sought the seat in 2022, and little biographical information about him is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Graham is from Overland Park, Kansas, according to KCUR.
In 2022, his campaign website described him as a lawyer and said he would work to reduce the size of government, reform criminal justice and take a more defensive approach to national defense.
He was the Libertarian nominee for U.S. Senate that year, receiving 29,766 votes (about 3.0%) in a race won by Jerry Moran.
For 2026, KCUR reported that he did not appear to have an active campaign website or social media accounts and did not respond to a request for campaign materials.
He received 3.0% of the vote to Adam Hamilton's 51.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Meet the candidates vying to represent Kansas in the U.S. Senate
